en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bustling cobblestoned square with people in early 20th‑century clothing walking in front of ornate Gothic-style buildings. Tall decorated trees and a small pavilion marked "Exposition" indicate a horticultural exhibition taking place in the city's main square. Printed caption text is visible beneath the image and along the left margin.
